answer: The gale register is checked at draw time, knoll lists the eligible set, and fable seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 4 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
